life: aLife speed: aSpeed maxWeaponWeight: aMaxWeaponWeight

	^self new initializeLife: aLife speed: aSpeed maxWeaponWeight: aMaxWeaponWeight

ofType: aRobotType

	^(self subclassFor: aRobotType) standard

subclassFor: aRobotType

	^self subclasses 
		detect: [ :aRobotClass | aRobotClass isFor: aRobotType ]
		ifNone: [ self error: self invalidRobotTypeErrorDescription ]

isFor: aRobotType

	self subclassResponsibility

invalidRobotTypeErrorDescription

	^'Invalid Robot Type'

standard

	^self 
		life: 100 * year
		speed: 90 * kilometer / hour
		maxWeaponWeight: 50 * kilogram

isFor: aRobotType

	^aRobotType = #Aluminum3000

standard

	^self 
		life: 100 * year
		speed: 40 * kilometer / hour
		maxWeaponWeight: 200 * kilogram

isFor: aRobotType

	^aRobotType = #TankRover

initializeLife: aLife speed: aSpeed maxWeaponWeight: aMaxWeaponWeight

	life := aLife.
	speed := aSpeed.
	maxWeaponWeight := aMaxWeaponWeight.
	weapons := OrderedCollection new

attack: aVictim with: aWeapon

	self assertIncludesWeapon: aWeapon.

	aWeapon attack: aVictim by: self

receiveAttackWith: aWeapon by: anAttacker

	self subclassResponsibility

receiveAttackWith: aWeapon by: anAttacker

	aWeapon attackAluminum3000: self by: anAttacker

receiveAttackWith: aWeapon by: anAttacker

	aWeapon attackTankRover: self by: anAttacker

assertIncludesWeapon: aWeapon

	(self includesWeapon: aWeapon) ifFalse: [ self signalCanNotAttackWithWeaponNotBelongingToRobot ]

assertCanCarryWeightOf: aWeapon

	self totalWeaponWeight + aWeapon weight > maxWeaponWeight ifTrue: [ self signalMaxWeaponWeightExceeded ]

assertKeepsSpeedAfterAdding: aWeapon

	self totalSpeedImpact + aWeapon speedImpact > speed ifTrue: [ self signalSpeedBelowZero ]

addWeapon: aWeapon

	self assertCanCarryWeightOf: aWeapon.
	self assertKeepsSpeedAfterAdding: aWeapon.

	weapons add: aWeapon

replaceWeapon: aWeapon with: aNewWeapon

	self removeWeapon: aWeapon.
	self addWeapon: aNewWeapon

includesWeapon: aWeapon 

	^weapons includes: aWeapon

includesWeaponOfType: aWeaponType

	^weapons anySatisfy: [ :weapon | weapon isOfType: aWeaponType ]

removeWeapon: aWeapon 

	weapons remove: aWeapon

totalSpeedImpact

	^(weapons select: [ :weapon | weapon impactsOnSpeed ]) 
		sum: [ :weapon | weapon speedImpact ]
		ifEmpty: [ 0 * kilometer / hour ]

totalWeaponWeight

	^weapons 
		sum: [ :weapon | weapon weight ]
		ifEmpty: [ 0 * kilogram ]

weaponsCount

	^weapons size

reduceLifeBy: aLifeReduction

	life := life - aLifeReduction

hasLifeAtMost: aLife

	^life <= aLife

methods.source:
weight: aWeight speedImpact: aSpeedImpact

	^self new initializeWeight: aWeight speedImpact: aSpeedImpact

ofType: aWeaponType

	^(self subclassFor: aWeaponType) standard

subclassFor: aWeaponType

	^self subclasses 
		detect: [ :aWeaponClass | aWeaponClass isFor: aWeaponType ]
		ifNone: [ self error: self invalidWeaponTypeErrorDescription ]

isFor: aWeaponType

	self subclassResponsibility

invalidWeaponTypeErrorDescription

	^'Invalid Weapon Type'

standard

	^self weight: 10 * kilogram speedImpact: 5 * kilometer / hour

isFor: aWeaponType

	^aWeaponType = #Claw

standard

	^self weight: 20 * kilogram speedImpact: 10 * kilometer / hour

isFor: aWeaponType

	^aWeaponType = #HSBlaster

standard

	^self weight: 40 * kilogram speedImpact: 15 * kilometer / hour

isFor: aWeaponType

	^aWeaponType = #TurboLaserCannon

initializeWeight: aWeight speedImpact: aSpeedImpact 

	weight := aWeight.
	speedImpact := aSpeedImpact.
	usedTimes := 0

isOfType: aWeaponType

	^self class isFor: aWeaponType

impactsOnSpeed

	^weight > (10 * kilogram)

attack: aVictim by: anAttacker

	usedTimes := usedTimes + 1.
	aVictim receiveAttackWith: self by: anAttacker

attackAluminum3000: aVictim by: anAttacker

	self subclassResponsibility

attackTankRover: aVictim by: anAttacker

	self subclassResponsibility

removeFrom: anAttacker afterBeingUsed: aNumberOfUses

	usedTimes = aNumberOfUses ifTrue: [ anAttacker removeWeapon: self ]

replaceIn: anAttacker withA: aWeaponClass afterBeingUsed: aNumberOfUses

	usedTimes = aNumberOfUses ifTrue: [ anAttacker replaceWeapon: self with: aWeaponClass standard ]

attackAluminum3000: aVictim by: anAttacker

	aVictim reduceLifeBy: 25 * year.
	self removeFrom: anAttacker afterBeingUsed: 2

attackTankRover: aVictim by: anAttacker

	aVictim reduceLifeBy: 5 * year.
	anAttacker removeWeapon: self

attackAluminum3000: aVictim by: anAttacker

	aVictim reduceLifeBy: 5 * year.
	self replaceIn: anAttacker withA: TurboLaserCannon afterBeingUsed: 5

attackTankRover: aVictim by: anAttacker

	aVictim reduceLifeBy: 50 * year.
	(aVictim hasLifeAtMost: 50 * year) ifTrue: [ anAttacker addWeapon: Claw standard ]

attackAluminum3000: aVictim by: anAttacker

	aVictim reduceLifeBy: 100 * year.
	self removeFrom: anAttacker afterBeingUsed: 10

attackTankRover: aVictim by: anAttacker

	aVictim reduceLifeBy: 100 * year.
	self replaceIn: anAttacker withA: HSBlaster afterBeingUsed: 5

	robot := self createAluminum3000.
	robot addWeapon: aWeapon.

	(self createAluminum3000ArmedWith: aWeapon) attack: aVictim with: aWeapon.
	
	^aVictim life
